skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand and apply fundamental theories of constitutional law and the legal framework of Vietnam.
Conduct independent research and accumulate knowledge on constitutional law and related legal frameworks.
Analyze and understand the foundational structures of Vietnamese society, including political, economic, cultural, and social systems.
Understand and apply knowledge on human rights and the rights and obligations of Vietnamese citizens.
Understand and apply knowledge on the organizational structure of the Vietnamese government.
Understand and apply knowledge on election laws and regulations.
Collaborate effectively in group settings and contribute to group projects.
Effectively present and communicate research findings.
Analyze and critically evaluate legal and political issues.
